queries:
SELECT observstation,
       AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage,
       COUNT(*) AS telescope_count,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation)) AS ratio
FROM telescopes
GROUP BY observstation
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH c AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
)
SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(telescope_count) FROM c) AS ratio
FROM c;
SELECT o.observstation,
       COUNT(t.telescregistry) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(t2.telescregistry) AS cnt FROM observatories o2 LEFT JOIN telescopes t2 ON t2.observstation = o2.observstation GROUP BY o2.observstation)) AS ratio
FROM observatories o
LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
GROUP BY o.observstation;
SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signals) AS REAL) / ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) FROM telescopes));
WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT t.observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  GROUP BY t.observstation
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT observstation, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM station_counts) AS ratio
FROM station_counts;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.observstation) AS station_count,
       CAST(COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.observstation) AS avg_telescopes_per_station
FROM telescopes t
JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation;
